jobs.title: Project Manager, Sample Solutions
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Project Manager, Sample Solutions based in India.

As a Project Manager, Sample Solutions, you will manage custom online market research projects from initiation through completion, ensuring quality, timeliness, and accurate execution.

You will oversee multiple concurrent projects, coordinating clients, vendors, internal teams, and research activities throughout the project lifecycle.

The role combines project management, client service, operational delivery, financial tracking, and risk management.

You will play an important part in maintaining strong client relationships through proactive communication and responsive issue resolution.

Working in a fast-paced environment, you will manage changing timelines, shifting priorities, and project requirements while maintaining high standards.

Your work will directly contribute to client satisfaction, operational efficiency, repeat business, and the successful delivery of research programs.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organized, analytical, and client-focused professional looking to grow within the market research and consumer insights space.

Accountabilities

End-to-End Project Management: Manage low-to-mid complexity custom online market research projects across the full lifecycle, including kickoffs, sample and quota setup, survey and screener testing, fieldwork launches, monitoring, quality checks, closeout, and debriefs.
Project Delivery: Manage multiple qualitative and quantitative projects simultaneously, ensuring milestones, scope, quality standards, and deadlines are consistently achieved.
Client Service: Build professional and collaborative client relationships through regular project updates, clear communication, timely responses, and effective issue resolution.
Quality Assurance: Conduct quality checks throughout fieldwork, monitor project performance, and ensure deliverables meet established standards and requirements.
Timeline & Scope Management: Track project milestones, respond effectively to changing deadlines and scope requirements, and maintain project momentum in a dynamic environment.
Financial Management: Maintain accurate project records, support revenue forecasting and reconciliations, coordinate invoicing, and track key financial and operational information.
Project Metrics: Monitor and report important project metrics, including field times, incidence rates, completion rates, and other indicators of project health.
Risk Management: Proactively identify feasibility, timeline, scope, and execution risks, escalating concerns appropriately and recommending practical solutions.
Vendor Coordination: Work with approved third-party vendors and outsourcing partners to meet study requirements while monitoring quality, performance, and delivery timelines.
Research Operations: Develop and apply knowledge of market research products, panel capabilities, respondent behavior, internal systems, and operational best practices.
Complex Projects: Support more specialized research projects, such as in-home usage tests, geofencing, and receipt-capture studies, with appropriate guidance.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work effectively with account teams, internal stakeholders, vendors, and clients to ensure smooth execution and positive project outcomes.

Requirements

Experience: 3+ years of relevant project management experience, ideally within market research, consumer insights, or a related field.
Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; an MBA in Marketing or a related discipline is a plus.
Research Knowledge: Understanding of market research and primary research methodologies, with the ability to apply this knowledge to project execution.
Client Service: Previous experience in customer-facing or client service roles is strongly preferred.
Communication: Exceptional written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and concisely.
Organization: Excellent time management, organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
Project Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, quality, and deadlines in a fast-changing environment.
Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to identify issues, assess risks, and develop appropriate solutions.
Technology: Familiarity with project management concepts and tools, with the ability to quickly learn new software and technologies.
Productivity Tools: Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Google Workspace applications.
Autonomy & Teamwork: Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with teams to achieve study-specific and departmental objectives.
Adaptability: Comfortable working with changing requirements, moving deadlines, and real-time operational priorities.
Flexibility: Willingness to work across different time zones and shifts; experience supporting weekend or after-hours coverage in a 24/7 environment is a plus.
Professionalism: Strong interpersonal skills, receptiveness to feedback, consistent communication, and the ability to maintain positive working relationships.

Benefits

Fully remote working opportunity in India.
Full-time position within a fast-paced consumer insights and digital marketing environment.
Opportunity to manage diverse market research projects and develop end-to-end project management expertise.
Exposure to clients, vendors, research methodologies, and large-scale project operations.
Opportunities to contribute to process improvements and operational best practices.
Collaborative environment with opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.
Ability to work with cross-functional and international teams.
Exposure to a dynamic environment where ownership, innovation, teamwork, and continuous improvement are valued.
Potential flexibility across time zones and working arrangements, depending on business and project requirements.

You will create and manage project plans, communicate schedules with different stakeholders and ensure successful delivery of all projects and tickets. You will work in a highly collaborative environment with a team that is geographically distributed. You will adhere to agile software development processes accepted by the organization. The candidate should have excellent analytical and interpersonal abilities and always looking to improve process and bring in efficiencies. Performs other duties as required.

Responsible for project management of assigned client implementations.

Actively manage risks, issues, actions, and dependencies through closure and communicate to maintain alignment.
Partner with the Account Management team to manage customer expectations through concise and timely communication.

Works well in a team and is flexible in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

Über die Atos Group

Die Atos Group ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter im Bereich der digitalen Transformation. Mit ca. 56.000 Mitarbeitenden und einem Jahresumsatz von ca. 7,2 Mrd. EUR (auf Basis des künftigen Unternehmenszuschnitts) agiert das Unternehmen in 54 Ländern unter zwei Marken Atos für Services und Eviden für Produkte und Systeme. jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Transgrid

At Transgrid, we play a crucial role in delivering safe, reliable, and sustainable energy to millions of Australians. Operating over 13,000 km of high-voltage transmission lines and 128 substations across NSW and the ACT, we connect electricity generators to the distribution network powering homes, businesses, and communities. As Australia accelerates its energy transition, the work we do has never been more significant.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Demand for electricity from data centres is one of the fastest growing load categories in the National Electricity Market. Hyperscale and enterprise operators are building across NSW at a pace the transmission network has not had to accommodate before and they need high-voltage connection infrastructure delivered quickly and reliably. Transgrid is the network owner responsible for making those connections happen.

We are looking for a Project Manager to take end-to-end delivery responsibility for assigned data centre connection projects. Reporting to the Senior Project Manager, you will manage the full project lifecycle across your scope including scope definition, schedule, budget, risk, contractor management, stakeholder engagement and governance. .

A DAY IN THE LIFE

Data centre projects move quickly and the stakeholder environment is broad. Your time will be split between the project office and substation construction sites across NSW.

Program Delivery and Schedule Management: Driving the project schedule across all workstreams from design and procurement through to construction and energisation, monitoring contractor performance and keeping scope, quality and cost on track against the customer in-service date.
Customer and External Stakeholder Management: Managing the relationship with data centre customers through the connection project lifecycle, keeping them informed of progress, managing expectations around milestones and escalating any issues that could affect their connection date early enough to do something about it.
Risk and Governance: Implementing the project risk management framework, maintaining a current risk register and supporting the Senior Project Manager in managing project decisions in accordance with Transgrid's frameworks and policies.
Contractor and Commercial Management: Managing delivery partners across civil and electrical construction scopes, applying commercial discipline to contracts, working through claims and variations and keeping accountability clear across the supply chain.
Stakeholder Coordination and Reporting:Coordinating across Transgrid business units, network operators, and third-party interfaces. Preparing Project Oversight Group packs, management plans and performance reporting for the Senior Project Manager and Project Director.
Site Presence: Being on site during critical phases of substation construction, switchgear installation and commissioning to maintain visibility of progress, resolve issues and make sure the project is tracking to the energisation plan.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Data centres are the physical infrastructure behind the digital economy. Every delay in getting a data centre connected to the transmission grid has downstream consequences for the businesses and communities that depend on them. Transgrid's ability to deliver connection projects on time is a direct input into NSW's capacity to attract and support technology investment at scale.

The projects in this portfolio are high-visibility, commercially significant and technically demanding. They require a Project Manager who can hold a complex program together, manage a demanding customer environment and deliver results consistently.

About You

You will have an engineering background and a track record of delivering capital projects in energy, heavy infrastructure or a similarly complex environment. You are commercially sharp, can manage stakeholders and understand what it takes to hold a construction program together under time pressure.

Tertiary qualifications at degree level in Engineering or a relevant discipline.
Demonstrated experience managing capital projects in energy, transmission, infrastructure or a similarly capital-intensive environment.
Experience managing customer-facing projects where in-service dates carry contractual or commercial obligations.
Solid understanding of high-voltage substation construction including switchgear, transformers, protection and control systems and energisation sequences.
Track record of managing contractors on complex construction projects with the commercial acumen to manage claims, variations and contractor performance.
Experience managing external customer relationships through a project lifecycle, including milestone communication, risk escalation and expectation management.
Strong stakeholder management skills across engineering, commercial, operations, customers and executive audiences.
High level of business and commercial acumen with experience in contract management and negotiation.
Collaborative working style with the ability to operate effectively across a matrixed organisation.
Willingness to travel to project sites across NSW as required.

Highly Desirable

Direct experience delivering data centre connection projects, contestable connection works or major customer connection assets on a transmission or distribution network.
Experience on high-voltage substation projects in Australia, particularly connection or augmentation works.
Exposure to AER regulatory frameworks or NER connection agreement obligations.
PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent project management certification.
Experience working within a principal or asset-owner project delivery framework.

OUR LEADERSHIP PRINCIPLES AND VALUES

Our Leadership Principles, Courage, Care, Clarity and Connection, form the foundation of how we lead at Transgrid. Courage means doing what is right even when it is hard. Care means valuing people and leading with genuine consideration for others. Clarity means making sure your team understands what good looks like and why their work matters. Connection means linking people to our purpose and building strong relationships across teams, customers and partners.

You will also uphold our Values: Safety, Achievement, Integrity and Service, delivering outcomes that are safe, sustainable and genuinely useful to the customers and communities we serve.

Benefits And Perks

At Transgrid, we empower our people with a well-rounded benefits package designed to support their personal, professional and social wellbeing, helping them deliver their best work every day.

20 Weeks Paid Parental Leave: Genuine support for every stage of family life.
Corporate Discounts: Retail, utilities, travel, health and wellbeing, and more.
Novated Leasing: Tax-effective vehicle options through novated leasing arrangements.
Workplace Flexibility: Flexible working arrangements to suit your life and your role.
Tertiary Education Support: Financial support for ongoing study and professional development.
Career Mentoring and Training: Regular training and career mentoring to help you grow.

Applications close on 30th of September 2026
however will be assessed on a rolling basis and may close earlier. Apply today and play a crucial role in driving the transition to a cleaner, more sustainable energy future!

Transgrid is committed to equal opportunity employment and creating an inclusive workplace where diversity is celebrated.

Job Description

This Opportunity

WSP is currently initiating a search for Lead Project Manager for our Salt Lake City, UT office. The following locations will also be considered: Phoenix, AZ; Helena, MT or Lakewood, CO. Be involved in projects with our US Mining Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our client’s objectives and solves their challenges.

In this role you will provide project management, project engineering, and project controls leadership for mining, mineral processing, metals, industrial water treatment, chemical processing, and heavy industrial projects across North America and internationally. You will be responsible for overall project delivery including financial, technical, client satisfaction, quality, safety, and schedule. You will ensure that responsibilities throughout the project lifecycle (proposal phase, project startup and planning, project execution, reporting, and project closeout) are completed to WSP and industry best standards for safety, execution, operational excellence, and profitability.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone interested in working closely with clients and leading a team of talented professionals.

Your Impact

Oversee and monitor cross-functional teams of technical professionals and subject matter experts to deliver multiple concurrent projects. Responsible for leading and monitoring scope, schedule, and budget. Responsible for overall project performance and key performance indicators such as SPI, CPI, engineering schedule, forecasting, resource utilization, etc.
Lead project teams delivering engineering studies, detailed engineering, EPCM, Owner’s Engineer, and other consulting delivery models, ensuring alignment with Client objectives, project governance requirements, and industry standards. Projects may include mining infrastructure, mineral processing facilities, hydrometallurgical plants, water treatment facilities, tailings storage facilities, and other major industrial developments.
Develop sufficient technical understanding of each discipline to effectively facilitate interdisciplinary coordination, identify project risks and interface issues, and support decision making throughout project execution. Disciplines include process, mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation and controls, civil, structural, geotechnical, water resources, and environmental.
Support business development including client relationship management, proposal development, project pursuits, contract negotiations, and resource planning.
Oversee and monitor cross-functional teams of engineers, planners, and scientific professionals to execute project work on mid-level and/or multiple concurrent projects, including budgets, tracking hours and expenses, task completion, cost and quantities of materials/equipment/labor, technical calculations, permit applications, schematics, construction, compliance documentation, and regulatory and technical analysis memos.
Establish and actively drive the appropriate levels of technical review required for the project, selecting appropriately qualified staff to perform the required reviews, and adherence to the QA/QC plan, as applicable.
Develop and update the Project Initiation/Setup Documentation including: Risk (REF/RMP), Project Management Plan (PMP), Project Quality Plan (QP), Project Safety (PSP), and Communications Plan, as necessary.
Complete formal project closeout activities, along with conducting and documenting a lessons-learned meeting with key project staff.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision-making regarding company funds, resources and conduct, and adhere to WSP’s Code of Conduct and related policies and procedures.
Perform additional responsibilities as required by business needs.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, science, or a related major, or equivalent experience in a technical or engineering firm.
7-10 years of relevant experience in a project engineering, project management, engineering management role within the Mining, Mineral Processing, Industrial Water Treatment, or Oil & Gas industries.
Well-defined knowledge of project delivery process within the architecture, engineering, and construction industry and strong background and experience in project management.
Highly proficient interpersonal and communication skills to interact effectively, persuasively, and tactfully with leadership, clients, subcontractors, and employees at all levels of the organization.
Experience being responsible for project financial performance and tracking and reporting on expenditures as well as forecasting estimated costs to complete.
Self- motivated with excellent verbal/written communication, problem solving, conflict resolution and decision-making skills.
High proficiency with technical writing, office automation, relevant software, MS Office suite products (e.g., Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), technology, spreadsheets, and PM tools.
Proven track record of upholding workplace safety and ability to abide by WSP’s health, safety and drug/alcohol and harassment policies.
Occasional travel may be required depending on project-specific requirements. Average expected travel is below 25%.
Must pass background check and be authorized for work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

Master’s Degree in Engineering.
Certifications preferred: (PE, PMP, MBA etc.).

ABOUT US

WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Risk Operations GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.

We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.

If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.

This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics
Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable
Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations
Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements
Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

Who you are

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.

You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion
Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences
Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks
Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments
Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales
Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Capital Technology Group provides expert consulting services software development, digital transformation, human-centered design, data analytics and visualization, and cybersecurity.

Our multidisciplinary teams use agile methodologies to rapidly and incrementally deliver value in close collaboration with our clients. For over a decade, we have been trusted by both federal and commercial clients to solve complex, mission-critical business challenges. The quality of our work has been recognized by our partners and peers through our inclusion in the Digital Services Coalition, a group of forward- thinking firms recognized for excellence in delivering IT services.

Client Requirements:
applicants MUST BE
US Citizens and be able to obtain Public Trust clearance

The CTG Experience

At Capital Technology Group (CTG), our teams are passionate about modernizing how the federal government delivers software. We partner with federal agencies to build secure, scalable, and mission-driven solutions that make a meaningful impact on millions of people. Recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace in 2025 and 2026.
CTG fosters a culture rooted in our core values. Our values guide how we work together and support one another, creating an environment where employees feel trusted, empowered, and encouraged to grow both personally and professionally.

About the Role

We are currently seeking a Program Manager
with experience overseeing the successful delivery of multiple projects within a program. You will be key in managing program performance, coordinating cross-functional teams, and ensuring the program's overall success. You will play a key role in expanding our program's reach and impact by identifying strategic opportunities, developing compelling proposals, and fostering strong relationships with partners and stakeholders. Your strong interpersonal skills and situational awareness will enable you to navigate complex customer dynamics effectively and contribute to a collaborative and productive team environment.

You Will Get To

Oversee the delivery of a program with multiple projects, ensuring they align with client objectives and are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget
Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams, including developers, analysts, and business stakeholders
Monitor and report on key program performance metrics, such as budget, timeline, and other KPIs
Identify, assess, and mitigate risks, providing proactive solutions and strategies to address potential issues and keep the program on track
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing their expectations, addressing concerns, and maintaining strong, effective relationships
Drive continuous improvement within the program, encouraging innovation, optimizing processes, and ensuring the consistent delivery of high-quality results
Drive program growth and client satisfaction by identifying opportunities to deliver operational excellence, contributing to compelling proposals, and cultivating long-term partnerships that result in repeat business
Serve as the primary Account Manager for the program, collaborating closely with cross-functional Account Managers to ensure all program KPIs and performance metrics are achieved

Who You Are

A servant leader who enjoys helping teams collaborate, deliver value, and continuously improve
Skilled at facilitating conversations and building alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders
Comfortable managing competing priorities within complex, enterprise-scale environments
Organized, proactive, and solutions-oriented when addressing delivery challenges
An effective communicator who can adapt messaging for a variety of audiences
Passionate about Agile methodologies, team development, and mission-driven work
Able to navigate ambiguity while maintaining focus on delivery objectives and customer outcomes

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
8+ years of professional experience
supporting software development, project delivery, or Agile programs
PMP or PMI-ACP Certification
Strong communication, leadership, and team management skills, combined with a strong attention to detail
Proven ability to manage large, complex programs with multiple stakeholders
Ability to build a solid rapport with customers
Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate project and program risks
Capable of aligning overarching strategic goals with the effective execution of detailed, day-to-day operations

Nice to Have

Federal government experience or prior work as a federal employee
Experience supporting government agencies or federal contracts

Salary

We are committed to offering a competitive salary for this position, with an estimated range of $110k–$150k annually
. Please note that this range is intended to provide a general idea of what to expect. The final offer may vary based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Full Time Employee Benefits

Remote Work (Hybrid roles will be specified in the job post)
Competitive Compensation Package
Medical, Dental, and Vision
Life Insurance, Short/Long Term Disability
Employee Assistance Program
401(k) with 4% matching
Liberal PTO vacation policy
Generous Annual Continuing Education
Annual Wellness Budget
Bonus Incentive Programs (Employee referrals and performance-based rewards)

Thanks for your interest in Capital Technology Group!

jobs.description:
About The Role

The Integrated Supply Chain CPMO Team is looking for a Project Manager.  As we manage through the demand for continuous improvement, implementing new processes, tools, and ways of working across Gore, project management capabilities are a critical success factor. The Gore Medical Supply Chain function’s CPMO consists of project and change managers that support the execution of work across supply chain functions and end-to-end processes that align to our annual and strategic priorities.

This position will be located at our facility in Phoenix or Flagstaff, Arizona, Elkton Maryland, or Sunnyvale California, with the possibility of a hybrid work arrangement.

Pay And Benefits

$120,000 - $155,000 per year
Roles above $150k are eligible for the variable pay program each fiscal year, based on defined business performance metrics.
Factors considered in extending an offer within this pay range include (but not limited to) education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities.
Medical, Dental and Vision benefits effective on Day 1 of employment! We offer a comprehensive total rewards package, including competitive benefits. More details are available at www.gore.com/careers/benefits

Responsibilities

Lead the successful delivery of multiple high-impact projects and/or large-scale programs simultaneously, leveraging the Supply Chain PM Standard Work to oversee planning, execution, governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement throughout the project lifecycle.
Develop and orchestrate integrated program schedules across numerous interconnected workstreams, ensuring alignment of dependencies, resources, milestones, and decision points to achieve program objectives.
Leveraging technical knowledge and subject matter experts to partner with leadership, project teams and stakeholders in defining scope, resourcing needs, estimates and execution strategies.
Align stakeholders on milestones, delivery schedule, issue resolution, costs; and project outcomes; this may also include the development and implementation of coordinated communication and/or change management plans.
Facilitates key project decisions and ensure decisions, actions and outcomes are appropriately documented and communicated.
Drive the identification of project and benefit metrics to assess project health, performance and achievement of desired outcomes.
Monitor off track actions and critical path activities and proactively identify, assess, mitigate, and escalate risks, issues, resource constraints and decisions that may impact project delivery.
Utilize daily management practices to drive resolution to off track tasks and critical path activities ensuring visibility, problem solving and escalation that ensures on time delivery of work.
Engage actively with the CPMO team to share best practices, leverage organizational knowledge, and contribute to the continuous improvement of project management standards, tools, and methodologies. This includes mentoring other team members and sponsoring individuals within Gore in project management.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management or a related technical discipline; equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered
Minimum of 2 years of experience in an engineering role (Quality, Process, Industrial, or other), or Supply Chain function (procurement, planning, finished goods, commercial operations, etc.)
Minimum of 5 years of project/program experience; Experience applying project management tools in a regulated or quality focused environment.
Proficient in software tools that advance project management methodologies – MS Project, MindJet, Jira, Excel and/or MS Planner.
Proven ability to plan strategically and engage tactically to both develop the plan and work hands-on to implement the plan
Demonstrated ability to design and develop project plans and project delivery strategies for complex projects and/or multiple workstreams simultaneously
Demonstrated ability to coach and effectively influence Associates without direct organizational authority both one on one and in a team setting.
Excellent written and oral communication skills including sharing complex information with a broad range of audiences
Demonstrated ability to work in a complex, dynamic and ambiguous environment.
Ability to travel up to 10%

Desired Qualifications

Project Management Professional, PMP, or equivalent project management certifications.
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
Solid understanding of change management methodologies and impact on project execution in a regulated environment

This position offers a hybrid work arrangement in the country from which the Associate is employed. Eligibility is dependent on the responsibilities of the role and business needs, and the Associate must agree to comply with Gore’s work arrangement policies.

What We Offer

Our success is based on the capability and creativity of our Associates, and we are proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive total rewards program that supports your everyday and helps you build your tomorrow.

We provide benefits that offer choice and flexibility and promote overall well-being. And in keeping with our belief that every Associate should share in the collective success of the enterprise; we provide a distinctive Associate Stock Ownership Plan in each country as well as potential opportunities for “profit-sharing”. Learn more at gore.com/careers/benefits

jobs.description:
About Cretex Medical

Cretex Medical is a leading contract manufacturer of precision components and assemblies for the medical device industry. Our customers view us as a trusted partner in the areas of injection molding, laser processing, metal stamping and device assembly. Learn more at www.cretexmedical.com.

Position Summary

The Program Manager will support the Laser Processing business unit, and will be responsible for facilitating all aspects of the engineering projects for assigned customers from the early prototyping stage all the way into a production program. This position acts as the customer advocate and leads customer programs that ensures compliance to customer, industry, and company requirements and standards. This position may supervise employees.

Program Manager Responsibilities

Administer and manage customer projects through the new product engineering stage gate process to meet requirements, scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - VP
jobs.description:
Embark on a transformative journey as a Senior Project Manager - VP. At Barclays, our vision is clear –to redefine the future of banking and help craft innovative solutions. You will work with the Corporate and Payment Portfolio Execution Team, a multidisciplinary organization responsible for driving the bank’s most strategic and complex change programs. The US Corporate Portfolio was launched to enhance the Corporate Bank’s offering by building on foundational technology and developing new capabilities that support a consistent, strategic international cash‑management experience for clients worldwide. In this role, you will contribute to expanding and improving client channels, introducing new product functionalities, enabling smart billing and strategic reporting, and delivering the automation and scalability necessary to stay competitive in the market and advance the growth goals of the ICB/GTB businesses. As part of the enterprise-wide transition to Agile ways of working, transformation initiatives will increasingly be delivered through Agile delivery models. Accordingly, applicants are expected to be well versed in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies and capable of adapting to a hybrid delivery environment as the organization progresses through this transformation.

To be successful as a Senior Project Manager - VP, you should have:

Proven leadership of large, complex change programmes, with the ability to set direction, drive execution, and inspire cross‑functional teams
Confirmed experience leading and facilitating Agile delivery as a Scrum Master, Release Train Engineer (RTE), or in a comparable Agile leadership capacity, with a good understanding of Agile frameworks, ceremonies, and delivery practices
Remarkable project and programme management capability, including planning, governance, risk management, dependency management, and delivery discipline
Outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and gain buy‑in from senior executives and diverse functional partners
Ability to work across global teams, navigating multiple regions, cultures, and regulatory contexts effectively

Other Highly Valued Skills May Include

Deep understanding of financial services transformation; prior experience in Corporate business and subject matter experience in FX, Liquidity and Payments Product suite highly advantageous but not essential
Certification or direct experience with Agile methodology as Release Train Engineer or otherwise highly preferred
Ample problem‑solving and decision‑making skills, with a history of delivering outcomes in fast‑moving or ambiguous environments

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in our New York, NY office.

Minimum Salary: $155,000

Maximum Salary: $225,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above includes only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

Purpose of the role

Responsible for broader, strategic objectives across multiple projects, with a long-term, cross-functional focus.

Accountabilities

Scope Management: Oversees a collection of related projects that together aim to achieve broader strategic business objectives. Their focus is on the long-term benefits and ensuring the alignment of projects with the organization’s goals.
Strategic Focus: Focuses on strategic, high-level outcomes. They are responsible for the overall success and continuous alignment of projects to the organization’s business strategy.
Time Horizon: Typically works over a longer time horizon, as programs may span months or years and involve multiple phases and projects.
Stakeholder Management: Manages a wide range of stakeholders across various projects, including executives, project managers, and external clients. They ensure communication and alignment across all projects within the program.
Risk and Issue Management: Manages risks and issues at a higher level, focusing on cross-project dependencies and potential impacts on the broader program or business strategy..
Resource Management: Responsible for allocating resources across multiple projects, balancing priorities, and ensuring that resources are used efficiently across the program.
Financial Management: Manages the overall program budget, tracking the financial health of multiple projects and ensuring that the program as a whole delivers value.
Metrics: Measures success based on the cumulative benefits delivered by all the projects within the program. They look at business outcomes, value creation, and alignment with strategic goals.
Change Management: Deals with change at a macro level, ensuring that changes across projects are managed cohesively and don’t negatively impact the overall program.

Vice President Expectations

To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Your Role

The Growth Strategy and Execution team is responsible for the orchestration of strategic planning and execution across the eight lines of business that make up the Growth organization. In this role you will function as a business and technical leader of large-scale initiatives of $5M+, partnering with business and technical product owners and managers to deliver required business outcomes and capabilities. The Principal Project Manager partners with multiple delivery portfolios and product teams to influence and improve product/initiative-based activities to achieve required business value.

Our leadership model is about developing great leaders at all levels and creating opportunities for our people to grow – personally, professionally, and financially. Manage large-scale, complex projects that involve multiple internal and external stakeholders

Develop the project charter, integrated project plan, resource plan, risk management plan, test plan and related project management artifacts

Job Description Summary

Job Description Summary

Under the guidance of the Director of Emergency Management, the Business Continuity Program Manager will support the development, implementation, management, and sustainment of the University of Kansas Medical Center's comprehensive Business Continuity Program, advancing organizational resilience and operational preparedness. The Program Manager will collaborate with academic, research, clinical, and administrative stakeholders to identify critical business functions, assess operational risks and vulnerabilities, and develop strategies that ensure continuity of operations during disruptions, emergencies, disasters, and technology outages.

Key responsibilities include leading and facilitating Business Impact Analyses (BIAs), conducting risk assessments, developing and maintaining Business Continuity Plans (BCPs), and coordinating the creation of departmental and enterprise downtime playbooks to support continued operations during system interruptions and other adverse events. The Business Continuity Program Manager will establish program standards, methodologies, and performance measures; support training, exercises, and plan validation activities; and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance organizational readiness and recovery capabilities.

The Program Manager will serve as a key partner in strengthening the institution's capacity to anticipate, withstand, respond to, and recover from disruptions while maintaining its mission of patient care, education, research, and service.

Program Framework & Standards

Work with internal business units to understand their specific business continuity and contingency needs.

Technology & IT Coordination

Training, Testing & Continuous Improvement

Develop and execute regular business continuity training, exercises, and required testing. Update plans regularly based on lessons learned.

Platform Administration

Emergency Response & Monitoring

Respond during emergency situations and incident management team activations.

Co-chair the BC/DR Committee.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Basis of Design & Standards
jobs.description:
About Nscale

Nscale is the GPU cloud engineered for AI. We provide cost-effective, high-performance infrastructure for AI start-ups and large enterprise customers. Nscale enables AI-focused companies to achieve superior results by reducing the complexity of AI development. Our GPU cloud bolsters technical capabilities and directly supports strategic business outcomes, including cost management, rapid innovation, and environmental responsibility.

Our Design & Engineering team owns the technical standards that every datacenter project is built on, from Basis of Design documents through equipment catalogs and scopes of work. As Nscale scales one of the most ambitious AI datacenter programs in the world, this team is the backbone that keeps design decisions consistent, current, and usable across every region.

We thrive on a culture of relentless innovation, ownership, and accountability, where every team member takes pride in their work and drives it with excellence and urgency. As an Nscaler, you'll build trust through openness and transparency, where everyone is inspired to do their best work. If you join our team, you'll be contributing to building the technology that powers the future.

About The Role

We're looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to own the program that keeps Nscale's design record aligned across every function that depends on it, including engineering, cost and schedule project controls, supply chain, construction, and operations.

You'll own the full catalog of Basis of Design documents, Scopes of Work, equipment catalogs, and Requirements evaluations across Nscale's global portfolio.
When a regional team starts a new project, they'll start from your catalog. When an engineer proposes a design change, you'll run the cross-functional review that gets it vetted, approved, and propagated.
This is a program management role rather than a design authoring role. You'll need enough technical fluency to hold credible conversations with discipline engineers, paired with strong program discipline, stakeholder management, and structured decision-making.
You'll treat cost per MW and schedule duration as first-class program inputs, not background context.
This role starts as an individual contributor, with the expectation that you'll build a small team and/or manage AI-assisted and contract resources as the catalog and program demand grow.

What You'll be Doing

Own the program that maintains and version-controls Nscale's full library of Basis of Design documents across all datacenter typologies, coordinating discipline engineers as content authors and reviewers.
Manage the library of Scopes of Work covering all major design disciplines, project types, and delivery strategies, driving them to a level of precision that supports accurate fee proposals and contract execution.
Own the change management program for all BoDs, SOWs, equipment catalogs, and design standards, from change request through discipline review, cost and schedule assessment, approval, versioning, and distribution.
Own the program that maintains approved equipment lists tied to each BoD, partnering with supply chain and procurement to validate availability, lead times, pricing, and vendor performance.
Own Nscale's Requirements evaluation framework, the structured technical assessment used to evaluate candidate colocation and leased datacenter facilities against Nscale's design standards.
Build and deliver structured "101" education programs on Nscale's design standards for internal teams, A/E partners, and external audiences.
Serve as the single point of coordination between design and the functions that consume design output, including cost and schedule project controls, supply chain, construction, operations, and Finance.
Identify and deploy AI tools and contract resources to scale document production, maintenance, and QA without proportional headcount growth.

About You

5+ years of experience in technical program management, project management, engineering, or design management within datacenters, mission-critical infrastructure, industrial facilities, or related capital-intensive construction.
Broad multi-discipline technical fluency across mechanical, electrical, civil, structural, and architectural systems, sufficient to review BoD content and hold credible conversations with discipline experts.
Demonstrated experience managing technical documentation programs such as Basis of Design documents, technical specifications, scopes of work, or equivalent design standards libraries.
Proven ability to drive alignment across functions that do not report to you, including engineering, cost and schedule project controls, supply chain, construction, and operations.
Strong process orientation, with experience designing and managing document control, change management, or configuration management workflows in a technical environment.
Working knowledge of cost/MW benchmarks and schedule duration assumptions for datacenter or mission-critical infrastructure design and construction.
Excellent technical writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn complex engineering intent into clear, unambiguous written standards.
Comfortable working with AI tools, document automation platforms, and digital collaboration environments.

Nice to Have

Direct experience with datacenter design, hyperscale AI infrastructure, colocation facilities, or power generation infrastructure.
Experience with colocation or leased facility evaluation frameworks, including technical due diligence, gap analysis, or cost-to-conform assessments.
Familiarity with BIM standards, design technology workflows, and how BoD content integrates with model-based design environments.
Experience with modular or prefabricated infrastructure design and the documentation requirements those delivery strategies create.
Professional Engineer (PE) license, Architectural license, or PMP a plus, though none are required.

Why this role matters

Nscale's regional design teams need a centralized, authoritative catalog of BoDs and SOWs to work from, without one, every project reinvents the wheel at the cost of speed, consistency, and quality. Design standards evolve constantly, and the equipment lists, cost/MW assumptions, and schedule durations embedded in them directly affect supply chain, construction, and financial planning. This role builds and owns that alignment layer.

As Nscale's portfolio grows, this program becomes the connective tissue between design strategy, project controls, supply chain, construction delivery, and operations. The person who builds it will have shaped how one of the most ambitious AI datacenter programs in the world makes, records, and communicates its design decisions.

What We Can Offer You

At Nscale, you'll find a collaborative, supportive, and innovative environment where your contributions spark real impact. We're building something extraordinary, and we want you at the core.

Highly competitive package (base + equity) with reviews every 12 months. 🚀
Join the fastest-growing tech startup, your chance to push boundaries, collaborate with brilliant minds, and make your mark on cutting-edge AI. ✨
Expect a dynamic progression plan tailored to your ambitions. Grow by trying new things, leading, challenging the status quo, and owning your impact, always with our full support.
Human-First Flexibility: We treat you as humans first. 🫶🏽 Our flexible workplace trusts Nscalers to deliver, giving you the autonomy to shape your day around life's moments.

Equal Opportunities Statement

At NScale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there's anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

The range below reflects the base salary for the position. Actual compensation may vary based on job-related factors such as skill set, experience, education, and location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for bonus, equity, and/or commission programs. Nscale may offer a competitive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, flexible paid time off, parental leave, and retirement plan participation.

Salary Range

$250,000—$300,000 USD

jobs.title: Program Manager, Risk Operations GTM Enablement
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Risk PMO team protects Stripe’s revenue and drives cross-functional strategy for company-level and org-level priorities. As Stripe operates across an increasingly complex and fast-moving global regulatory environment, one of our most important functions is ensuring that our largest, most strategic users can grow with us—compliantly, confidently, and at speed.

We sit at the intersection of Legal, Compliance, Engineering, Product, Data Science, and GTM—serving as the bridge between teams coordinating massive programs with global, wide-reaching impact. We build durable systems that enable strong collaboration across functions and seamless experiences for our users.

If you're energized by high-stakes, ambiguous problems and thrive on building programs from scratch in environments where the rules are still being written—we want to hear from you.

What you’ll do

You will define, own, and execute program strategies for large-scale regulatory initiatives, operating with significant autonomy across a portfolio of global projects.

This is a highly visible, senior individual contributor (IC) role. While you will influence senior leadership and set strategic direction, you are also the primary driver of execution. You will need to zoom out to design the long-term vision, and zoom in to manage the details—building templates, tracking deliverables, writing documentation, and directly unblocking cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Own and execute high-stakes global programs end-to-end, from initial strategy and scoping to project planning, day-to-day tracking, and change management
Drive step-change improvements in our operational processes, rolling up your sleeves to build systems and workflows that directly improve business outcomes and top-line metrics
Bridge compliance and commercial strategy by partnering with GTM and account leadership to turn complex regulatory requirements into a competitive advantage that builds deep user trust
Build and run operating models across diverse cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, Legal, Risk, and Compliance), keeping highly distributed workstreams aligned and accountable
Serve as a trusted advisor by preparing strategic reviews for senior stakeholders and managing critical escalations
Translate user friction into program evolution by establishing structured, data-driven approaches to gather user feedback and turning those insights into actionable product and operational improvements
Diagnose and resolve systemic operational gaps before they impact our users, building self-healing processes and scalable internal infrastructure
Champion Stripe’s Operating Principles by fostering a high-performance culture that values rigorous thinking, rapid execution, and putting users first

Who you are

You are a highly strategic operator, a masterful communicator, and a systems thinker with operational grit. You thrive in the gray area, possessing the ability to translate ambiguous global challenges into elegant, structured, and highly actionable operational frameworks.

You are a natural leader who leads by influence and by example. You have a deep empathy for the user, an unyielding bias toward action, and you take pride in the craft of execution. No problem is too complex for you to deconstruct, and no detail is too small if it impacts the user experience.

Minimum Requirements

6+ years of experience in Program Management, Strategy & Operations, Management Consulting, or Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Hands-on execution track record: Proven ability to work independently as an individual contributor, managing complex, multi-stakeholder project plans and deliverables from inception to completion
Exceptional communication & storytelling: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; a proven ability to distill highly complex, technical, or regulatory topics into clear, succinct, and persuasive narratives to external and senior audiences
Systems and infrastructure builder: Deep experience designing, launching, and scaling complex cross-functional operating models, feedback loops, and PMO frameworks
Growth mindset: A high willingness to learn, adapt quickly to changing environments, and actively seek and act on feedback to continuously improve

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of experience in high-growth technology or fintech environments
Deep cross-functional partnership: Prior experience working alongside Engineering, Product, Legal, Compliance, and GTM/Sales
Data fluency: Experience leveraging data visualization tools and analytical frameworks to back up strategic decisions and measure program success

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

As a Senior Project Manager

Your role will extend beyond project management to include business development and client expansion activities, where your expertise in environmental engineering, geology, or related fields will shine. Emergency Preparedness, Planning, and Drills

The right candidate is someone who has been through a data warehouse build before, understands what it takes to get it right from the start, and is energized by the challenge of turning complexity into clarity.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

1. Data Warehouse Leadership (Business Owner) 

Lead the end-to-end development of the Group Data Warehouse (DWH) from scratch by translating business needs into scalable data architecture and reporting structures. 
Define and shape data models with technical teams to ensure alignment with business requirements and prevent downstream reporting gaps. 
Prioritize high-impact use cases to guide DWH roadmap and ensure early business value delivery. 
Oversee data pipeline design and validation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and usability for reporting and analytics. 
Manage technical resources while driving timeline, quality, and delivery of the DWH.

Own the design and delivery of Group-level dashboards and reporting systems for GMT and BOD. 
Define and standardize KPI frameworks, performance scorecards, and reporting templates across subsidiaries. 
Ensure all reporting outputs are accurate, consistent, and aligned with agreed data definitions and governance standards. 
Continuously refine dashboards and reports based on leadership feedback to improve clarity and business relevance. 

3. Data Governance & Standardization 

Work alongside Group IC to co-build Group data governance framework covering data ownership, definitions, access policies, and quality standards. 
Drive data consistency across subsidiaries by standardizing KPI definitions, data structures, and reporting cadence. 
Ensure governance principles are embedded into both system architecture and reporting outputs across the Group. 

4. Business Insights & Performance Management 

Analyze Group-wide performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for growth and efficiency improvement. 
Lead monthly and quarterly performance reviews with clear, data-driven storytelling for leadership. 
Translate data into actionable insights to support strategic and operational decision-making. 

5. Squad Leadership & Stakeholder Management 

Lead and coordinate the data squad across subsidiaries to ensure alignment and effective execution of data initiatives.

Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into clear, actionable business insights. Solid understanding of forecasting, performance tracking, and business reporting across diversified portfolios
Strong SQL and working knowledge of data warehouse concepts to actively participate in architecture discussions, challenge data design decisions from business perspective
Strong project manager and relationships management, self-driven and comfortable working cross-functionally and influencing stakeholders

Collaborative mindset and experience working in cross-functional teams.

jobs.description:
Compensation Intelligence Senior Director Full-Time, Senior Individual Contributor

About The Role

This is a cross-functional role for a Senior Compensation Program Analyst who thrives in environments where the analytical and the advisory are inseparable. You will divide your time between quantitative research, client communication, and internal practice development within ACPWB's Compensation Intelligence group. The team numbers 9. They are, without exception, people you would want to work with. We recognize every job posting says this. We believe ours is accurate.

ACPWB's Compensation Intelligence practice is expanding its focus on pay-for-performance alignment analysis, and we are looking for a Senior Compensation Program Analyst who can operate at the level of rigor our clients demand. This position will report to the practice lead and manage a small team of 9 analysts, with the expectation of growing that team within 18 months, budget permitting, which it will.

The Senior Compensation Program Analyst will be responsible for the research and analytical work that powers some of ACPWB's most visible client engagements in the pay-for-performance alignment analysis space. We are a growing organization that does serious work — serious enough that we have patents — and this role is central to maintaining the analytical credibility that our clients and, frankly, our sales team depend on.

Key Responsibilities

◆ Develop deep expertise in pharmaceuticals and biotech compensation trends through research, peer networking, and client experience
◆ Support the design and implementation of annual total compensation statement programs for nonprofit and mission-driven organizations
◆ Build and maintain relationships with key client stakeholders at the VP, SVP, and C-suite level
◆ Serve as primary client contact for nonprofit and mission-driven organizations engagements across the full engagement lifecycle
◆ Develop training materials and process documentation to support team capability building
◆ Manage client relationships throughout the engagement lifecycle, including post-delivery follow-up and renewal

Qualifications

Required

◆ Strong written communication skills including the ability to draft board-level narrative from quantitative findings
◆ Demonstrated ability to build and sustain trust-based relationships with senior client stakeholders
◆ Experience leading structured analytical projects using project management tools and frameworks
◆ Experience with statistical modeling or regression analysis in a professional context

Preferred

◆ Experience with HRMS or compensation management software platforms
◆ Familiarity with FASB ASC 718 equity compensation accounting
◆ Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation
◆ Experience with R, Python, or other statistical programming languages

WHY ACPWB

ACPWB's approach to professional development is substantive rather than performative. Our training programs are structured. Our mentorship is specific and ongoing. Our internal mobility is real. We have promoted people from Analyst to Director within five years. We have also let people go who stopped growing. We believe both things are consistent with a culture that takes development seriously.

ACPWB was founded in Milwaukee in 2006 with a simple mandate: help working Americans understand and advocate for the compensation they deserve. Eighteen years later, that mandate has grown into a full-service research and advisory practice serving clients from early-stage employers to Fortune 50 enterprises — and we are still based in Milwaukee, because Milwaukee is genuinely underrated.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Our hiring process is direct and transparent: one phone screen, one technical interview, one final panel. We aim to complete the process within three weeks of initial contact. We will tell you where you stand at each stage, because we believe that is the right thing to do.

What Success Looks Like In Year One

◆ Reach a level of autonomous delivery where your manager trusts you to own a client workstream independently
◆ Lead at least one client kick-off meeting independently or with minimal support
◆ Establish a regular cadence with your manager for feedback, development planning, and career discussion
◆ Build productive working relationships with team members across at least three internal practice areas

Responsibilities include providing project management leadership, as well as establishing and maintaining outstanding project management tools and practices for quality-based initiatives. As our third Project Manager, you will join a collaborative team reporting directly to the Director of Quality and Outcomes, partnering on the initiatives that drive our clinical outcomes, publicly reported performance, and value-based care results. In this role, you will lead cross-functional projects spanning clinical operations, quality improvement, and care coordination—working closely with physician leaders, nursing, care management, and health information management to move projects from concept to sustained results. Strong leadership skills and ability to facilitate cross functional teams.
Strong project management skills, ability to manage multiple projects at once.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
