Functional Consultant/ Project Manager

Great Team, Opportunity for Career & Professional Development, Collaborative and Meritocratic work culture and Supportive Leadership

About Us

At Medius, we believe managing finance should be about strategy, not stress. That same mindset shapes not only the solutions we build, but also the culture we create for our people. We remove complexity, embrace innovation, and give our teams the freedom to focus on what truly matters — whether that’s transforming the future of finance with AI or finding balance to go home on time.

Founded in Sweden in 2001, Medius has grown from a local startup into a global leader in cloud-based spend management solutions. Today, thousands of organizations worldwide trust us to simplify accounts payable and spend management processes. Our journey has been driven by continuous innovation, a passion for technology, and above all — the people who make it happen.

We’re more than a software company. We’re a team of problem-solvers, innovators and collaborators working together to reinvent the category of accounts payable. Our solutions use Artificial Intelligence to eliminate manual work, bring clarity, confidence, and control, and empower finance teams of the future.

At Medius,
our values guide how we work and grow together:

Connect – We believe in the power of people—individually and collectively—and our success depends on understanding and respecting each other. We appreciate that ‘empowering finance teams of the future’ is an exciting endeavor, and we share it with everyone around us.
Question – We enjoy the challenge of our work and the thrill of collaboration. We are not afraid to question ourselves and each other because we believe diverse perspectives can lead to better outcomes and that there is great power in resolution.
Own – We are thorough, thoughtful, and decisive. We anticipate what’s next, what a customer might need, and then we deliver. That’s how we get things done. And that’s how we remain a leader. Customers trust us to do our job so that they can focus on what they do best.

At Medius, you’ll join a diverse, global community where curiosity is celebrated, ideas matter, and innovation never stops. If you’re passionate about technology, eager to make an impact, and ready to grow alongside a team that lives its values, Medius is where you can do your best work — your impact is global.

Learn more at www.medius.com

Job Overview

As a Project Manager / Functional Consultant
, you will join the Medius Professional Services team and lead projects implementing our spend management suite for customers. From day one, you will take on significant responsibility, managing complex and engaging projects across both local and international markets.

You will guide customers through the full onboarding lifecycle, including solution design, deployment, UAT, go-live, and hypercare. This is a hybrid role combining project management and functional consulting responsibilities. Depending on project scope and complexity, you may focus on one area or balance both, with opportunities over time to specialize based on your strengths and interests.

Responsibilities And Duties

Lead end-to-end project delivery, including planning, resourcing, milestone tracking, and budget management
Facilitate workshops and deliver training sessions (on-site or remote)
Configure Medius solutions based on customer requirements and best practices
Support customers throughout testing phases, go-live, and hypercare
Analyze customers’ existing spend management processes and identify improvement opportunities
Drive process optimization initiatives in collaboration with customers
Produce and maintain solution documentation, including specifications and change requests
Provide regular reporting and updates to project stakeholders

Qualifications

Minimum 5 years of experience in IT system implementations, ideally in cloud-based/SaaS environments as a Functional Consultant
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset
Business-oriented and results-driven approach
Ability to manage multiple parallel tasks while maintaining quality and control
Solid understanding of IT systems and implementation methodologies
Fluency in French and English, both written and spoken

Preferred:

Experience in Spend Management solutions
Previous experience in a consulting role
Familiarity with ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics AX / Finance & Operations, Dynamics NAV / Business Central, SAP, or Infor M3
Medius is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

Actual compensation will be determined based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, experience, qualifications, certifications, internal equity, and the geographic location in which the role is performed. Compensation may vary for roles performed in different locations due to differences in the cost of labor.

The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for variable compensation (such as a performance bonus or commission), benefits, and/or participation in other incentive or benefit plans, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. Benefits may include medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, and retirement benefits, subject to eligibility requirements.

Medius is an equal opportunity employer
. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity or expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability (physical or mental), genetic information, medical condition, marital status, citizenship or immigration status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

If you require a reasonable accommodation due to a disability or for religious reasons during the application or interview process, please review our accommodations process.

We’re an employee-centric business

The most important thing to our organization is our employees – and we really mean it.

Worldwide workforce, top talent

Medius is a global business, with hubs in some of world’s major cities. We employ those that ooze our values, so you’ll learn from the brightest minds.

Our leadership team is carefully selected from some of the leading minds in spend management and experts from their respective disciplines. They’ll encourage and inspire you to be better at your job. For more information, please visit medius.com.

new_jobs.title: Flight Test Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Über uns

Skysec Defence
ist ein Schweizer Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung modernster C-UAS (Counter-Unmanned Aircraft Systems) Lösungen spezialisiert hat.

Mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Software-, Elektronik-, System- und Entwicklungsingenieuren arbeiten wir an der Spitze der Drohnentechnologie und entwickeln Systeme, die neue Massstäbe in der Luftabwehr setzen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Flight-Testing-Teams
suchen wir per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine engagierte und verantwortungsbewusste Persönlichkeit als Flight Test Data Analyst
.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest direkt mit Daten aus realen Flugversuchen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Systeme.

Deine Analysen bilden die Grundlage für nachvollziehbare Testberichte, fundierte technische Entscheidungen und die Verbesserung unserer Systemmodelle. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du den Aufbau eines digitalen Zwillings, der zukünftig eine zentrale Rolle in Simulation, Entwicklung und Validierung einnehmen wird.

Wir suchen eine analytisch starke Persönlichkeit, die aus komplexen Messdaten klare Erkenntnisse gewinnt und diese in verlässliche Entscheidungsgrundlagen übersetzt.

Anforderungen

Das bringst du mit

Aus- und Weiterbildung: Du verfügst über einen Masterabschluss in Data Science, Aerospace Engineering, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik, Physik, Mathematik, Statistik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen oder naturwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.
Berufserfahrung: Du hast in technischen Projekten die Datenanalyse durchgeführt.
Fundierte Datenanalysekenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung in der strukturierten Aufbereitung, Analyse und Interpretation komplexer technischer Datensätze.
Programmierkenntnisse: Du kannst Datenanalysen mit geeigneten Programmiersprachen und Werkzeugen selbstständig umsetzen und automatisieren.
Weitere Skills: Qualitätsbewusstsein, analytische Arbeitsweise, hohe Eigenverantwortung und technisches Verständnis
Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du kannst Analyseergebnisse sowohl für technische Fachpersonen als auch für weitere Projektbeteiligte klar und verständlich aufbereiten.
Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Engagement: Du identifizierst dich mit der Mission und den Zielen von Skysec Defence, übernimmst Ownership und bringst dich mit hohem Einsatz und Verantwortungsbewusstsein in deinen Aufgabenbereich und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens ein.

Angebot

Was wir dir bieten

Motivierendes Umfeld

Flache Hierarchien, klare Ziele und moderne Technologie

Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Gleitarbeitszeit für eine gute Work-Life-Balance

Zukunftstechnologie

Arbeite an der Drohnentechnologie von morgen mit

Bezahlte Zertifizierungen

Drohnenprüfungen, Erneuerungen und relevante Weiterbildungen werden unterstützt

Innovation wird gefördert

Deine Ideen sind willkommen und werden aktiv weiterverfolgt

Gratis Kaffee

Bester Kaffee der Kaffeerösterei Küng, kostenlos für alle

Fitness-Abo

Vergünstigtes Fitness-Abo direkt neben dem Büro

Attraktive Konditionen

Attraktive Vergütung und wachsende Sozialleistungen

Team-Events

Regelmässige Teamevents, Apéros und gemeinsame Essen

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
